description: This source file defines data structures and functions for handling schema-based configuration, including schema nodes, UI hints, and path-based traversal logic for configuration schemas.

classes.name: ConfigPathSegment
classes.description: An enumeration representing a segment of a configuration path, either as a key string or an index integer.

classes.name: ConfigUiHint
classes.description: A structure representing UI hints for configuration fields, such as label, help text, order, and visibility options.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaNode
classes.description: A class encapsulating a node in a configuration schema, providing properties to access schema attributes like title, description, type, and child nodes, along with methods for schema traversal.

methods.name: decodeUiHints
methods.description: Decodes a raw dictionary into a dictionary of ConfigUiHints keyed by strings.

methods.name: hintForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the most relevant UI hint for a given configuration path, considering wildcard matches.

methods.name: isSensitivePath
methods.description: Determines if a configuration path pertains to sensitive information such as tokens or passwords.

methods.name: pathKey
methods.description: Generates a string key representing a configuration path by concatenating key segments.
